summary.answer: Takes points and consumes the six return values from GetRankAndRankData. If its second result is nil, returns blacktransparent and zero. Otherwise returns the second result's exact hashed asset field and points minus the sixth result. That object and subtraction are unguarded beyond the second-result nil test. Takes an XUID. Starts with an empty rank string, blacktransparent icon and nil extra result. For XUID unequal to numeric zero, queries Engine hash_62000A30A9678274 and passes its points/bestSubdivisionRank/firstSubdivisionRankTotal to GetRankAndIcon. Returns only the rank-string result. Nil is not excluded by the XUID-not-zero test and the queried object is indexed without a nil guard. Takes an XUID. Starts with blacktransparent icon and default rank/extra values. For XUID unequal to numeric zero, queries the same native ladder-data provider and assigns GetRankAndIcon's rank/icon/extra results from its fields. Returns only the icon. The data object's shape and lifetime are external and unguarded.
